title: Nashville 2BR for 6 + Rooftop — Near Five Points
description:
✔️ East Nashville location ~7 miles to downtown
✔️ Private rooftop deck for sunrise coffee, sunset cocktails
✔️ 2 bedrooms, 2.5 baths — sleeps up to 6
✔️ Walk to dining, bars, parks, and greenways
✔️ Full kitchen with stainless appliances
✔️ Garage parking and in‑home laundry

The space
• Outlaw Oasis blends modern style with easy East Nashville energy
• Start the day on the rooftop deck, then wander to local coffee and brunch
• After outings, stream a favorite show in the bright living room
• Cook together, grab counter stools, or gather at the dining table
• Perfect for families, friends, or business travelers seeking calm near the action

🌅 Indoor & Outdoor Living
• Sunny living room with smart TV for streaming
• Private rooftop deck for morning coffee and evening hangs
• Central AC/heat for year‑round comfort
• In‑home washer and dryer for easy stays

🛏️ Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 6)
• This home includes 2 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms.
• Bedroom 1 — Queen bed; smart TV; ensuite with walk‑in shower
• Bedroom 2 — Full‑over‑full bunk plus single/twin bed; smart TV; ensuite with walk‑in shower
• Half bath — On the main living level

🍳 Kitchen & Dining
• Full kitchen with stainless steel appliances
• Ample counter space and island seating for casual bites
• Dining table for shared meals and game nights
• Cookware, bakeware, utensils, are provided
• Salt, pepper, and cooking oil are not provided

🏖️ What's Included
• In‑unit/home washer and dryer for longer stays
• We provide bedding, towels and a small starter set of essentials
• Smart TVs in living room and both bedrooms
• Wi‑Fi for work and streaming

📍 Location Highlights
• Downtown Nashville — honky‑tonks and Broadway ~7 miles
• South Inglewood Park — playgrounds, fields, and trails nearby
• Shelby Bottoms Greenway — biking, birding, river overlooks
• East Nashville eats and nightlife — bars, coffee, and brunch spots
• Nissan Stadium and Five Points — quick rides away

🚗 Parking, Safety & Notes
• Parking is available for up to 2 vehicle(s) in the private garage
• This is a multi‑level townhouse—stairs required, including rooftop access
• Laundry: Private washer and dryer in home
• Wi‑Fi: Provided; speeds may vary based on carrier and usage
• Pets: This home is not pet friendly. If there is found evidence of an animal's presence during your stay or post check‑out, guests will be charged an additional cleaning fee
• Check‑in time is 4:00 PM and checkout time is 10:00 AM
